verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports code-based tasks deployed via git/GitHub Actions, giving implicit versioning through source control and deploy history, and prompt templates can be 'versioned on deploy' with dashboard overrides. However there's no evidence of a dedicated UI-level version history, diff/review workflow, or one-click rollback mechanism for automations themselves. missing for 10: dedicated version history/diff view for tasks, explicit rollback-to-previous-version feature, review/approval workflow for automation changes (approval token is for runtime pauses, not code review).
